notes.title: Another Sale, Another Contest!
notes.notes:
As you know, right now we're celebrating the Lunar New Year with a big sale, and we want to have another contest!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/f9367cdd85708c5d19c10aa64103fdae456dc9ee.png[/img]
[i]You can play as any character![/i]

Like before, you´ll need to make a good score to win a free PIXELMAN key. This time it's going to be a little different, you need to make enough points to get into the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/438000/leaderboards/2428739?sr=1]Top 15 in Arcade Mode[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/1d8bf49fb373143b8f4477f7be23dcf45e3224b5.png[/img]
[i]Big Ben's Score in the one to beat![/i]

Currently to get in you need to make more than 53,300 points. Every time someone gets into the Top 15 it's going to make it harder for the rest, so act fast, you don't need to stay there, just get in, take a screenshot and send it to us!

You can give this key to anyone you want, no restrictions!

Here's the rules:

[b]1) Make enough points to get into the Arcade Mode's Top 15 leaderboard (Tip: Keep your rescue combo going no matter what!).
2) Post a screenshot of your score in PIXELMAN's community boards.
3) Add this account (KindermannCorp) to your friends list (So we can send you the key).
4) Only 1 key per account during the Lunar New Year Sale.
5) The offer ends on February 11th 4PM PST.[/b]


That's it! Score high, get a free key, and give the gift of PIXELMAN!

Good luck, and may the rescue combo be with you!

notes.title: 1.5.0.13 The Competitive Update
notes.notes:
This update brings something we think is really cool, the Next High Score button!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/c8ac6e0b90261229f91e6b4bbb58398c4b22afe0.png[/img]
[i]Check that beautiful button out![/i] 

With it activated you can -while you're playing- see how many points you need to make to reach the next player in the global leaderboards, it also lets you know when you destroy their scores!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/ed93e88445d94207ea7f004dfce1e86750f24182.png[/img]
[i]I have a long way to go...[b]*SHAKES FIST AT RICKYEL*[/b][/i]

You need to have played at least once a level for it to kick in, so don't worry if you don't see it at first (it needs to have a prior high score for it to work).

AND if you don't care for it, you can deactivate it on the select your hero screen : )

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/780ba4ec139d943b24335776cff7988d56761935.png[/img]
[i]Who would want to deactivate this awesome feature?[/i]

Also, now if you're in the top 3 on any of the leaderboards, you're going to get a shiny beautiful cup next to you on the podium!
If someone takes your place the cup is gone, so keep improving your scores because some players are getting really good at rescuing people!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/df5c47ba17ed7d5e83f90dcbadc4d42d3828a828.png[/img]
[i]I got the silver cup![/i]

We also have some cool new stuff like tips when you beat one of the bosses (they also show up when you pause the game) and some other things behind the curtains.

Let us know what you think in the comments!

Thank you for playing! ːpmokːːpmsmileːːpmvictoryː

notes.title: 1.5.0.12 - The Cowboy Hat Update
notes.notes:
Howdy heroes of Pixville!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/286c1aaca849c524d0abaca6190b028cafddbc25.png[/img]
[i]You've got to see this beauty in motion![/i]

You might have noticed we updated PIXELMAN a few times since the full launch. We found a few bugs that needed to be squashed, and also after watching a few Youtuber videos we realized the Easy setting was too similar to Medium, so we tweaked the difficulty levels a little bit (it's still challenging like we originally intended, but now we hope more people will get to see the later levels!).

Since we were updating the game, we also decided to include a little feature we always talked about but never found the time to implement. You can now grab the cowboy hats from the crowd and wear them!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/53db7756d4ecac725866fd77aed9bdc14fea1931.png[/img]
[i]Thousands of hours of render time were [b]not[/b] used in the making of this hat.[/i]

To do it simply fly over a citizen that's wearing a hat, or catch it in mid-air when they throw them. And you will have a cool hat!
But beware, if you get hit by ANYTHING it'll fly away...

A big AAA developer would charge people 10 dollars for the Cowboy Hat DLC, and we're doing it for free, because we love you! ːpmvictoryːːpmsmileːːpmvictoryː

Thank you for being the hero Pixville needs!

notes.title: PIXELMAN now runs at 60FPS!
notes.notes:
Good news everybody!

Finally after a few unforeseen issues we released the 60fps update!

PIXELMAN now plays super smooth on almost every computer we've tested it on, and, for the people with on-board videocards or just plain old computers, we added a few graphic options so they can play it anyways!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11994821/a638bf7c337212fbf244b1f511f6c982d912d3c5.png[/img]
If the game runs slow at 60fps, go to options and first try to run it on a window instead of full screen (you can also use alt+enter to toggle FS & Window modes on the fly). If that doesn't work, disable V-Sync, aaaaand if that doesn't work either, you can disable the High Quality mode, if you do that the game will revert back to 30fps mode.

We've noticed that laptops with Nvidia graphics cards tend to default to the on-board Intel card for PIXELMAN, so if you have a laptop with a Nvidia graphics card and the game runs slow for you, make sure you change the default card for PIXELMAN (right click on pixelman(dot)exe/run with graphics processor/change default...).

Also! We changed the endless level names from easy/med/hard to countryside/city/space (yes, the hard level will be in space) because most players thought that the game only had one level. Hopefully with this change more people will try all the levels!

Now we're back on track working on the Hard/Space level and after that the Arcade mode!

Thank you all for playing and stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Next Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've been quiet these past weeks, with the craziness of the Summer sale and the Endless Easy update, we didn't have time for anything else!

But now we're working on the next update, which is going to be the most requested feature since we started Early Access on Steam. [b]60 FPS![/b] ːpmhornsːːpmsmileːːpmhornsː

When we started working on the game, we wanted it to play well on every computer, old and new, since it's a pixelart game, most people expect that to be the case, even if the game is doing a ton of stuff on the background.

But looking at the stats now, most of you have super awesome computers that can play this game (and any game) at 60FPS like it's nothing, so it doesn't make sense anymore to limit everyone just to keep a few players happy.

30 was rough on most players eyes, so we need to keep the majority of gamers happy.

Why not give the players the option to play in 30 or 60 fps? Because the game is super complicated, it has hundreds of timers which have to be changed for it to work in any of the speeds, and having both options would mean that we'd need to push back all the other updates (Endless Hard and Arcade mode) for months.

We're confident that 99% of you will be able to run the game just fine after the update, and will like it even more than before because it´ll be buttery smooth. But if we get too many complains for people that can't play anymore we´ll consider having a switch in the future, but we hope it's not going to be necessary. 

The 60FPS update is coming in the next few weeks (we need to do a ton of testing on that one) you'll hear it from us when it's done!

Thank you for playing! You're awesome!

notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Y7tz6Lh.png[/img]
The reason PIXELMAN is in Early Access is that we needed more time to develop more awesome stuff, the game you're playing right now is just the Medium Endless Level. PIXELMAN will have both Easy and Hard levels, and also the Arcade Mode with bosses!

Easy Endless: Country fields, with barns, windmills, cows and farm animals.

Medium Endless: The City of Pixville you play in now.

Hard Endless: ??? (we will tell you when it's time).

Arcade mode, the 3 levels together, with end level bosses and an ending!

Every level will have it's own leaderboard, so you might be great at playing endless, but can you deal with the bosses?

Easy level will be released in the next few weeks, and soon after that hard and Arcade. Stay tuned! ːpmhornsːːpmsmileːːpmhornsː
